speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help diagnose your chronic cough and recurrent bronchitis, could you tell me how long this has been going on and do you currently smoke or have you smoked in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. The patient has been experiencing an aggressive cough producing copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum for about 11 years, with exacerbations similar to the current presentation today. Reports that the cough is worse in the morning and has had multiple evaluations in the past due to recurrent bouts of bronchitis requiring antibiotics treatment. The patient is a non-smoker.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of recurrent sinusitis or nasal polyps, and do you experience shortness of breath during daily activities? Also, has there been any weight loss or fever associated with these episodes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Aggressive cough with thick, yellow-green sputum. I also have Cough worse in the morning, History of recurrent bronchitis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of recurrent sinus infections or nasal polyps? Also, do you experience any gastrointestinal symptoms like diarrhea or malabsorption?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No other significant past medical history aside from the recurrent bronchitis. Social history: Non-smoker, no history of alcohol or drug abuse.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a family history of similar respiratory issues, and have you ever been tested for cystic fibrosis or alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency? REQUEST TEST: Sweat_Cl_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal sweat test, I need to rule out structural airway abnormalities. REQUEST TEST: High-Resolution CT Chest

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the chronic nature of your cough and recurrent infections despite normal sweat and CT results, I need to evaluate your lung function and check for allergic triggers. REQUEST TEST: Spirometry with bronchodilator response and IgE levels.
